risks: LOAD PATH THAT SUMS TO ZERO, form 1 — unanchored MT. If the MT's far end is free, MT-pushes-nucleus is an internal force couple: Σ|f| is large, every joint is loaded, and the net force is zero, so the pair simply drifts and neither body deforms. This is the crawl-traction failure in a new compartment. Mitigation: mt_cortex_capture or a Dirichlet MTOC is a REQUIREMENT of the in-situ gate, and N8 measures |Σf|/Σ|f| explicitly with the isotropic aster as the designed-in demonstration of the zero case.

LOAD PATH THAT SUMS TO ZERO, form 2 — symmetric aster. A physiologically symmetric MT aster gives net-zero load on the nucleus even when perfectly connected. Reporting one scalar would read this as 'not connected'. Mitigation: connectedness (Σ|f| > 0, per-face strain nonzero) and net translocation (|Σf| > 0) are reported as TWO verdicts that may never be merged; N8's negative control demonstrates that the scalar-only variant of the gate fails.

METRIC MEASURING THE WRONG THING, form 1 — translation read as deformation. Nucleus centroid displacement is not nuclear deformation. Mitigation: Procrustes removal of translation+rotation before any strain claim; centroid displacement and residual strain reported as separate quantities.

METRIC MEASURING THE WRONG THING, form 2 — volume conserved by construction. If K_vol is large, V/V0 = 1.000 regardless of physics, exactly the documented A/A0 = V/V0 = 1.000 tautology. Mitigation: the K_vol = 0 negative control must show volume CHANGING, and the conservation gate is a −1 exponent in K_vol, not an absolute closeness to 1.

METRIC MEASURING THE WRONG THING, form 3 — probe compliance read as nucleus stiffness. A penalty indenter puts k_probe in series and the measured k is dominated by whichever is softer, turning k_probe into an empirical magic number. Mitigation: prescribed displacement with contact-node Dirichlet pinning as the primary protocol; the penalty variant kept only as the negative control that must FAIL the Reissner-ratio gate.

GATE THAT CANNOT FAIL. The historic example tested largest-fragment vs second-largest instead of absolute connectivity. The in-situ transmission gate is structurally at risk of the same thing: 'nucleus moved' is trivially satisfiable by any tiny numerical drift. Mitigation: every zero/nonzero claim is referenced to a mesh-noise floor measured on an unloaded converged run, and N7 carries an explicit positive control (nucleus nodes pinned) whose only acceptable outcome is that the gate FAILS.

UNRESOLVED MESH masquerading as physics. The default nucleus is subdiv 3 (642 nodes, 1280 faces) and the audit already found the GATE-A residual to be the un-refined nucleus block while the membrane was refined for exactly this reason. A shell indentation boundary layer thinner than one triangle edge produces a stiffness that is a mesh artifact. Mitigation: boundary-layer > mean-edge admissibility check is a hard precondition on reporting any stiffness; every exponent gate repeated at subdiv 3/4/5; expect subdiv 3 to FAIL and treat that as the finding.

UNCONVERGED EQUILIBRIUM. Nucleus bending/areal/volume stiffness currently sits in the scalar regularizer (implicit_mechanics.py:1430-1446), not in K_analytic. The last time a nucleus number was quoted from a bespoke fixed-iteration descent with no convergence test it became the audit's finding #6. Mitigation: nucleus-block residual as an explicit convergence criterion, NucleusImplicitCG with real tangents, and a relaxation-length sensitivity arm (the nmii_sf_motor precedent: 10× relax moved T by 3.4×, so the magnitude was withheld — do the same here).

HIDDEN CHANNEL DOING THE WORK (the SettlingForce class of failure: a lumped proxy at 19,000–47,000× real magnitude, ON in every committed run, mislabelled proxy_off, credited to the lamellipodium). Mitigation: N8 arm (iv) — every declared coupling off — must give EXACTLY zero nucleus reaction and bit-identical position. Any nonzero is a HALT to PI, not a small correction. Plus the per-channel ledger with a static assertion that the declared channel set equals the launched set.

DOUBLE COUNTING at the seam. Binding an engine-owned nucleus while driver.py:157 still accumulates the incumbent's nucleus gives an exact factor of 2 that looks like a plausible stiffening. Mitigation: N0's parity gate with the omit-mask-off arm as the designed-in negative control, plus pointer-identity assertions.

DOUBLE COUNTING in the constitutive model. If the explicit chromatin WLC net is added while k_chrom stays inside the lumped areal k_soft, the chromatin contribution is counted twice — and the second count is invisible because both are labelled 'chromatin'. This is a modelling decision, not a bug to be fixed silently; it is in the PI queue.

LINC AS A RIGID WELD. A permanently-bound tether population at a large enough k_linc reproduces the co-location failure through a different door: the nucleus moves rigidly with the MT and 'perfect transmission' is reported. Mitigation: the dimensionless weld parameter W = k_linc·N_linc / k_shell is reported on every run and W ≫ 1 auto-labels the run RIGID-WELD REGIME, which cannot support a transmission claim. The tension-only law (ext > 0) and barycentric — never nearest-vertex — socket are also non-negotiable.

DENSITY AS A MESH KNOB. linc_per_node=1 makes LINC areal density a function of nucleus subdivision, the identical defect the audit found in erm_density_per_um2 and explicitly noted is 'named nowhere' for LINC. Every refinement study then silently changes the biology it is supposed to hold fixed. Mitigation: explicit density in the manifest; N9's negative control exposes the current default.

IRREVERSIBILITY CONTAMINATING THE ELASTIC GATES. eps_rupture sits at the TEST value 0.50 that its own parameter file says not to keep. If a face tears mid-sweep, the path-independence gate fails for a physical reason and could be misread as a solver defect. Mitigation: rupture OFF for the reversibility gates with max face strain vs threshold reported every run; rupture ON only in its own arm.

STALE WARP KERNEL CACHE producing byte-identical false positives after a kernel edit (a documented project trap: an old 3-D cache once 'proved' 645 invariance). Mitigation: cache clear is a step in the N1 protocol and should be in the runner, not the operator's memory.

SUMMARY DRIFT. The audit's dominant finding is that documentation runs one evidence rung ahead of the executable layer, including a rung hard-coded into an npz. Mitigation: no artifact from this track may contain an evidence string it did not earn; every quantitative number carries a BLOCKED label; connectedness is reported as CUDA_UNIT until a registered graph carries the reaction in a coupled candidate, and the word CONNECTED is not written into machine-readable output by the script that produces it.
open_questions_for_pi: CHROMATIN REPRESENTATION AND THE DOUBLE-COUNT. Three options: (a) build the explicit crosslinked WLC net (fine-grained rule says yes; link count / contour length / persistence / crosslink topology are all unsourced, so magnitudes are BLOCKED) and REMOVE k_chrom from the lumped areal k_soft; (b) keep the lumped areal term and defer the net; (c) run both with a declared mapping gate (net → effective areal modulus). Option (a) without removing k_chrom is a silent double count. This decision determines whether stage (a) can separate shell from chromatin at all, so it is the top blocker.

LINC KINETICS VS MECHANICS. May the connectedness gate run with all mt_nucleus_linc joints in a declared permanently-BOUND state, kinetics explicitly BLOCKED (linc_connector.py:1254 correctly refuses to invent rates)? Or must bind/unbind rates be sourced first — which blocks the entire in-situ gate indefinitely? The PI priority says connectedness is the gate and magnitudes are not, which argues for permanently-bound-and-labelled, but this is a contract call.

WHICH MT→NUCLEUS MECHANISM IS BEING DEMONSTRATED. The declared chemistry card is microtubule_motor_linc, but three physically distinct mechanisms are available and they differ in SIGN: (i) a passive nesprin/SUN–MT tether (pulls, tension-only); (ii) a dynein/kinesin motor walking the lattice and pulling the envelope (active, directional); (iii) a plus-end pushing as a polymerizing compression strut (pushes). The gate's sign-sense criterion depends entirely on which. Pick one as the primary, or authorize all three as separate labelled arms.

MT FAR-END ANCHORING. mt_cortex_capture (a real dynein-capture connector, more work, physiologically right) versus a Dirichlet MTOC (a boundary condition, cheaper, and a declared model limit)? Without one of them the in-situ gate is vacuous, so this is not deferrable.

NUCLEUS MESH RESOLUTION AS PRODUCTION BASELINE. subdiv 3 (642 nodes) is the current default and is very likely to fail the boundary-layer admissibility check. Is refining to subdiv 5 (~10k nodes) authorized as the baseline, with its memory and wall-time cost, or is the coarse mesh retained with an explicit 'shell indentation response UNRESOLVED' limitation carried on every artifact? Note the membrane was already refined 3→8 for precisely this reason.

STANDALONE-NUCLEUS BASELINE STATE. Isolated nucleus in buffer (no surrounding pressure — matches how isolated-nucleus AFM/micropipette experiments are done) versus in-situ pre-stressed (nucleoplasm pressure and surrounding cytosol pressure at their physiological setpoints — what the physiological-baseline hard rule prescribes)? This is not cosmetic: it decides whether the small-δ regime is bending-dominated (Reissner) or tension-dominated (Young-Laplace), i.e. which analytic oracle the gate is measured against.

INDENTATION PROTOCOL. Spherical AFM-like indenter, flat plate, or micropipette aspiration as the reference protocol for the standalone nucleus? Measurement-protocol consistency means this should match whichever published protocol we eventually compare against, and the project has already been burnt twice by a metric whose protocol did not match its name.

RUPTURE ON OR OFF DURING THE MECHANISM GATES. eps_rupture stands at the TEST value 0.50 that params_i0b2.yaml says explicitly not to keep. Physiologically the channel should be ON; but ON destroys path-independence by design and contaminates the reversibility theorem gate. Proposal is OFF for the elastic gates with peak strain reported, ON only in its own arm — needs ratification.

THE FROZEN-INCUMBENT SEAM (Card 5 omit-mask). Authorizing the driver to skip its own nucleus accumulation so the engine owner can own it is a strangler-retirement step on a feature-frozen module. Everything in this track sits behind it. Needs the Card-5 decision, not a workaround.

SCOPE OF THE PERINUCLEAR ACTIN CAP. actin_cap_linc is the other nucleus load path and shares the same connector code. Keeping it OFF makes MT attribution unambiguous; turning it ON is closer to the adherent baseline the PI specified but confounds the attribution. Recommend OFF for this track and a separate cap track — confirm.

WHAT COUNTS AS EVIDENCE FOR 'MT TRANSMITS FORCE TO THE NUCLEUS'. Is a converged static in-situ step with nonzero connector reaction, closed Newton-3rd and work, a strictly-zero LINC-off control, and a grid-invariant transmission ratio sufficient to call mt_nucleus_linc force-real and the nucleus CONNECTED — or is a dynamic multi-step run with a real acceptance predicate required first? The audit's standing objection is that no native run yet has an integrator inside the engine's own step, a physical acceptance predicate, or a converged residual; this track should not be the fourth to claim a rung without them.

result.track: Track 5 — Cytosol / CFD: Darcy vs Stokes (fluid-momentum decision)
result.current_state:
HEADLINE ANSWER FIRST (the PI is right about the principle, wrong about where to spend it):

Darcy's k IS a lumped proxy and the hard rule does favour resolving the flow. But the numbers decide *where* resolving it buys anything. The Brinkman screening length in this medium is ell_B = sqrt(k). With the project's own k = 5e-18 m^2 (ac/fluid/params_i0b1.yaml:k_perm) ell_B = 2.24 nm; re-derived independently from the project's own cortex population (70,686 filaments x 3 um over a 706.9 um^2 x 0.2 um shell = 1500 um filament/um^3 -> xi = 1/sqrt(rho_L) = 25.8 nm, k = xi^2/C for C=16..72 -> 0.93-4.2e-17 m^2) ell_B = 3.0-6.5 nm. The viscous term mu*lap(v) beats the Darcy term mu/k*v only at scales below ell_B: the ratio is exactly (ell_B/L)^2 = 2.0e-5 at L=0.5 um (today's grid cell) and 8.9e-8 at L=7.5 um (the cell). So at the whole-cell scale Darcy is not a convenience approximation of Stokes — it is the leading-order asymptotic limit of Stokes in this medium, with relative error O(k/L^2) ~ 1e-5..1e-7. Buying that last 1e-5 by brute force costs ~4e11 grid cells (below). THE FINE-GRAINED MOVE IS THEREFORE NOT "SOLVE STOKES EVERYWHERE" — IT IS (a) MEASURE k_ij AND phi FROM THE EXPLICIT FILAMENT GEOMETRY BY POREx-SCALE STOKES DNS IN A ~1 um REV (which de-lumps the one genuinely lumped number, is affordable, and converts k+phi from inputs into outputs per PI priority 5), and (b) RUN STOKES-BRINKMAN, NOT DARCY, WHERE FREE FLUID ACTUALLY EXISTS: the extracellular MEDIA the PI's own baseline specifies, the cell-substrate lubrication film, bleb interiors, the perinuclear gap. In those regions k -> infinity, ell_B -> infinity, and Darcy is not an approximation but simply wrong. Today there is NO extracellular fluid at all.

DOF comparison against the solid (494,802 nodes = 1,484,406 positional DOF, 11.9 MB per fp64 vector field): dx=50 nm gives 1.41e7 active cells x 4 unknowns = 5.7e7 -> 38x the solid; dx=10 nm -> 7.1e9 -> 4,800x; dx=2 nm -> 8.8e11 -> 600,000x. Wall time (memory-bound stencil, 8 arrays/sweep at 500 GB/s, MG V-cycle ~ 8 fine-sweep-equivalents, ~15 outer Krylov iterations, x5 FSI coupling iterations per outer physical step): dx=250 nm -> 8 ms/outer step; dx=100 nm -> 0.13 s; dx=50 nm -> 1.04 s. Today's whole Biot step is microseconds. So even the AFFORDABLE Brinkman grid raises fluid cost by 1e4-1e5x and would dominate the simulator, in direct tension with PI priority 4 (speed). CONCLUSION: full-cell resolved-DNS Stokes is 3-6 orders of magnitude beyond any hardware the project will have; that is not "higher implementation cost", it is infeasible by construction. Whole-cell Stokes-BRINKMAN at 100-250 nm IS affordable and is a genuine physics upgrade (adds shear, vorticity, no-slip on large surfaces, free-fluid regions, and a velocity-difference drag). Pore-scale DNS in a REV IS affordable and is where k and phi get de-lumped: a 1x1x0.4 um cortex patch at dx=2 nm = 5.0e7 cells = 3.0 GB for 15 fields (filament 4 cells across, ~600 um of filament inside); a 0.5^3 um bulk patch at dx=2 nm = 1.56e7 cells = 0.94 GB (35 pores/axis); at dx=1 nm = 7.5 GB, still fits.

MIDDLE-GROUND RANKING FOR A WARP KERNEL IMPLEMENTATION
1. BEST — matrix-free geometric-multigrid Stokes-Brinkman on the EXISTING FieldGrid, MAC/staggered: mu*lap(v) - (mu/k)v = grad p, div v = 0. It is one code path that degenerates EXACTLY to today's Darcy as k->0 and to pure Stokes as k->inf (free-fluid pockets, media, blebs, lubrication film) — so it subsumes the incumbent rather than replacing it, and the k->0 limit is a bit-comparable regression oracle. Operators are 7-point stencils plus a divergence constraint: ideal for Warp (no FFT needed, and Warp ships no FFT, which rules out spectral/Ewald splittings). Reuses FieldGrid, Domain masks, boundary.py, PressureCoupling, the Peskin kernels, and the whole oracle set.
2. GOOD, WITH A TRAP — immersed-boundary node coupling on top of (1). The spread/interp kernels and their adjoint gate already exist (ff/biot_fluid_warp.py:131,169; ac/fluid/ibm_reference.py). THE TRAP: the Peskin blob's effective hydrodynamic radius is ~dx, so at dx=100 nm each actin node presents a 100 nm blob instead of a 4 nm filament; Stokes drag scales with a, so the per-node drag would be ~25x too large while LOOKING like resolved hydrodynamics. That is precisely the metrics-measuring-the-wrong-thing pattern this repo has hit seven times. It must be gated (step S6 negative control) and corrected by a Rotne-Prager-Yamakawa near-field term with the true filament radius, or restricted to structures larger than dx (membrane, nuclear envelope, SF bundles, MT).
3. RIGHT TOOL FOR ONE JOB ONLY — regularised Stokeslets / boundary integral (BEM): surface-only unknowns, exact 1/r far field, no truncation error, and a rigorous 6*pi*mu*a*v oracle. Ideal for the EXTERIOR MEDIA bath on the membrane mesh (2,562-40,962 vertices) where an unbounded domain is otherwise expensive. NOT viable for interior filaments: a dense mobility over 494,802 nodes is (3N)^2 = 2.2e12 entries, and the O(N log N) fixes (FMM, PME/Ewald) need an FFT Warp does not have.
4. REJECT — Lattice-Boltzmann, despite its GPU reputation. Four independent reasons: (a) it stores 19-27 distributions per cell, i.e. ~2x the memory of an MG Stokes solver, and memory is the binding constraint; (b) it is a weakly-compressible Navier-Stokes solver, so it REINTRODUCES the inertia this project deliberately deleted at Re=1e-10 — a wrong-physics regression wearing a performance costume; (c) it reaches steady Stokes by hyperbolic/diffusive relaxation over L^2/nu lattice steps, but the coupled solve needs the STEADY elliptic solution every outer step — wrong solver class; (d) at Ma -> 0 the pressure-velocity coupling becomes ill-conditioned and the standard fixes push tau to the stability edge.

WHAT DARCY DOES AND DOES NOT DELIVER, ON THE PI'S THREE WANTS
(a) Visible interior flow — PARTIALLY DELIVERED, and this is where the honest answer is more favourable to the incumbent than expected. Darcy gives a genuine cell-centred vec3 VELOCITY field, not merely a flux: velocity.py reconstructs v_f = v_s + q/phi and the native run measured max|v_f - v_s| = 0.474 um/s (ng4_payload.json), a physiologically sensible streaming speed (Pe = 0.47*7.5/3 = 1.2, so advection is marginally relevant at the undrained transient, contra the steady-state Pe<<1 claim in docs/cfd_transport_program). It is fully visualisable as glyphs/streamlines. BUT it is a volume-averaged superficial velocity, it is IRROTATIONAL for uniform k, and it carries no shear or boundary layer — so no vortex, no recirculation, no shear layer can ever appear. THAT is the specific, structural thing Darcy cannot show.
(b) Real volume exchange — FULLY DELIVERED, not a Darcy deficit: MembraneFluxBC J = L_p(sigma*dPi - dP) with the content==flux identity closing to machine precision, wired at CONNECTED (cytosol_connected.py).
(c) Drag on filaments from the fluid rather than a per-node friction coefficient — NOT DELIVERED, and this is the real gap. The only fluid->solid force is -alpha*V*grad(p), proportional to grad p, so a filament moving through quiescent uniform-pressure fluid feels zero fluid force. Getting fluid-borne drag does NOT require resolved Stokes: the Darcy-consistent form is the Brinkman body force (mu/k)(v_f - v_s), available at Darcy cost — and its coefficient mu/k is exactly the lumped number the REV DNS can MEASURE instead of assume. That is the fine-grained route to (c).

THE DOUBLE-COUNT: EXACTLY WHAT MUST BE REMOVED IN THE SAME COMMIT
Today nothing double-counts, for a reason worth stating plainly: the ac engine's mechanics is a QUASI-STATIC descent with dt_mu = 0.1/kmax (ac/cell/driver.py:7-10) and NO physical drag force at all; ac/engine/sf_implicit.py:459-479 mobility_step = dt/gamma is a CFL-derived numerical mobility, not dissipation. The 65.9 Pa*s appears only as a 0-D time-scale (ff/network_warp.py:886 gamma_node = 6*pi*eta*R/Nc, :891 _dt_real = dt_mu/_mu_phys) and as a per-node force in the UNWIRED ff/motility_warp.py. So the hazard is created by the NEXT wiring step, whichever it is. If a velocity-difference fluid drag (Brinkman or IBM-Stokes) lands, these must be removed or reclassified in the SAME commit:
  1. ff/motility_warp.py:407-431 physical_node_gammas() — DELETE from any path that also has fluid drag. Not down-rate: eta_cyto/eta_solvent = 65.9/1e-3, so keeping both is a ~65,900x error on that channel, not 2x. The 65.9 Pa*s IS the poroelastic composite that (mu/k)(v_f - v_s) reconstructs.
  2. ff/units.py:140 fiber_point_drag(..., eta=ETA_CYTOPLASM default) — remove the default so no runtime path can reach the bulk viscosity implicitly.
  3. ff/units.py:67 fiber_point_drag_solvent (gamma_solid at eta=1e-3) — with a resolved-blob IBM/Brinkman coupling even this double-counts, because the solvent drag on a filament is what the fluid solve computes. It may survive ONLY as a solver preconditioner/numerical mobility, must be labelled as such, and must be EXCLUDED from every dissipation/energy ledger.
  4. ff/network_warp.py:886,891,1432 — the 0-D 6*pi*eta*R clock. Not a force, but a second inconsistent physical clock once the fluid sets time. Retirement is already the documented plan (FSI_WIRING_DESIGN_2026-07-16.md); it must actually happen in that commit.
  5. ff/implicit_ff.py:170 MODAL whole-cell 6*pi*eta*R crawl drag — this is precisely what an exterior Stokes bath computes. If the bath lands, delete; if it does not, the exterior drag stays lumped and must be labelled lumped in forces_manifest.
  6. ac/nucleus/params_i0b2.yaml:172-179 gamma_nuc = 6*pi*eta_nuc*a_Stokes — legitimate ONLY while the nucleoplasm stays a no-flux hole outside the fluid domain (it currently is). If the fluid domain is ever extended inside the envelope, this double-counts.
  7. ac/engine/sf_implicit.py, ac/cell/implicit_mechanics.py mobility_step — numerical only; must never be reported as a physical viscosity.
The enforcement mechanism already exists in skeletal form: ac/engine/forces_manifest.py is the force-channel OBSERVER built specifically because a lumped SettlingForce ran at 19,000-47,000x real weight while recording proxy_off. It currently has no drag/dissipation channels. Extending it into a VELOCITY-PROPORTIONAL-FORCE CENSUS asserting exactly one owner per dissipation channel is the cheapest, highest-value item on this whole track and is step S0.

validation_steps.step: S0 — Velocity-proportional-force census (dissipation single-ownership gate)
validation_steps.what_is_measured: The complete enumerated set of terms in the assembled force residual that are proportional to a velocity or to a mobility, each tagged with owner, magnitude, provenance (SOURCED / DERIVED / PI_GAP / NUMERICAL-ONLY), and enabled-state read from the live composed object — plus an assertion that each physical dissipation channel has exactly ONE owner.
validation_steps.protocol: Extend ffn_sim/ac/engine/forces_manifest.py (the existing OBSERVER, built after the SettlingForce proxy_off incident) with a dissipation section that observes, read-only: ff/units.py fiber_point_drag / fiber_point_drag_solvent reachability, ff/motility_warp.py:407 physical_node_gammas, ff/network_warp.py:886 gamma_node and :891 _dt_real, ff/implicit_ff.py:170 modal drag, ac/nucleus/params_i0b2.yaml gamma_nuc, ac/engine/sf_implicit.py mobility_step, ac/cell/driver.py dt_mu, and (once it exists) the Brinkman/IBM drag. Classify each as PHYSICAL-DISSIPATION or NUMERICAL-MOBILITY. Emit a machine-readable manifest; add a pytest that fails if any two enabled channels claim PHYSICAL-DISSIPATION on the same (component, velocity) pair, and that fails if a channel is 'unobserved' rather than explicitly on/off. Never coerce absence to off.
validation_steps.pass_criterion: Exactly one enabled PHYSICAL-DISSIPATION owner per (component, velocity) pair; zero channels reported 'unobserved'; every NUMERICAL-MOBILITY entry is excluded from the dissipation ledger by construction. Purely structural — no magnitude needed.
validation_steps.negative_control: Inject a test double that enables BOTH ff/motility_warp.py physical_node_gammas (eta=65.9) and a Brinkman drag on the same cortex nodes. The gate MUST fail and MUST name both owners. Second control: mark a channel enabled=None/unobserved and confirm the gate fails rather than defaulting it to off (the exact proxy_off shape).

validation_steps.step: S1 — Prove or refute that today's Darcy velocity field is a potential flow (the structural deficit, measured not argued)
validation_steps.what_is_measured: curl(q) and curl(v_f) over the live fluid mask on the existing native run; and the shear rate at the cortex/membrane/nuclear surfaces implied by the field.
validation_steps.protocol: On the committed native dump (ac/cell/dump_coupled.py already writes p, q, v_f, div_vs at dx=0.5 um) compute the discrete curl of q on the FLUID cells and normalise by |q|/dx. Repeat with an ARTIFICIALLY non-uniform k(x) field (k varying by 10x across the cortex/interior boundary) to confirm the only vorticity source is grad(k) x grad(p). Report max and p95 of the normalised vorticity, plus the tangential velocity at the first fluid cell adjacent to every OUTSIDE/NUCLEUS face.
validation_steps.pass_criterion: For uniform k: normalised |curl q| at round-off (<1e-12 relative), confirming the field is IRROTATIONAL by construction. For non-uniform k: |curl q| tracks |grad k x grad p|/mu with a log-log slope of 1.00 +/- 0.05 in the imposed k-contrast. Both are exact-identity / scaling-exponent criteria requiring no physiological magnitude. Outcome either way is a FINDING for PI: it quantifies exactly which visual features Darcy can and cannot ever show.
validation_steps.negative_control: Feed the diagnostic a synthetic solid-body-rotation velocity field (v = omega x r), whose analytic curl is 2*omega. The gate must report a LARGE non-zero vorticity — i.e. the diagnostic must be capable of detecting vorticity, otherwise the round-off result in the real case is a gate a broken build cannot fail.

validation_steps.step: S2 — Stokes solver correctness on magnitude-free oracles (build the solver, prove it is Stokes)
validation_steps.what_is_measured: Discrete incompressibility; Poiseuille velocity-profile SHAPE ratio; Stokes drag coefficient on a sphere; Lorentz reciprocity and exact reversibility; linearity/superposition; observed spatial convergence order against a manufactured solution.
validation_steps.protocol: Write a matrix-free MAC/staggered Stokes-Brinkman operator (mu*lap(v) - (mu/k)v = grad p, div v = 0) with geometric multigrid, as Warp kernels on the existing FieldGrid + Domain mask; ac/fluid/fv_reference.py-style NumPy twin for CPU gating. Then run: (a) max |discrete div v| after projection; (b) plane channel, free fluid (k -> inf), driven by a pressure gradient — measure u_max/u_mean; (c) no-slip sphere of radius a >= 8*dx in a periodic box, measure F/(mu*a*v) and apply the Hasimoto periodic correction 1/(1 - 1.7601(a/L) + ...); (d) two independent boundary-velocity problems u1,u2 on the same geometry, evaluate the reciprocity residual |int u1.t2 dS - int u2.t1 dS| / max(|int u1.t2 dS|,|int u2.t1 dS|), and separately negate every boundary velocity and check the field negates exactly; (e) solve for f1, f2, and f1+f2 and measure the superposition residual; (f) manufactured divergence-free solution, L2 error at dx, dx/2, dx/4.
validation_steps.pass_criterion: (a) max|div v| <= solver tolerance and at round-off for the projected field. (b) u_max/u_mean = 1.5000 +/- 0.002 in 2D plane channel (a pure SHAPE ratio — no magnitude). (c) F/(6*pi*mu*a*v) -> 1 within the Hasimoto correction, converging at the discretisation order. (d) reciprocity residual and reversal antisymmetry both at round-off. (e) superposition residual at round-off. (f) observed order 2.0 +/- 0.15. Every criterion is an exact identity, a dimensionless shape ratio, an analytic oracle, or a convergence exponent.
validation_steps.negative_control: Per gate: (a) replace the pressure projection with a single Jacobi smoothing pass — divergence must be O(1) relative and the gate must FAIL. (b) run the SAME channel with the incumbent Darcy operator — plug flow, u_max/u_mean = 1.000, gate must FAIL. This single control is the cheapest quantitative Darcy-vs-Stokes discriminator in the whole track. (c) switch the sphere to free-slip — must land on 4*pi*mu*a*v and FAIL a 6*pi gate. (d) add an advective u.grad(u) term or a first-order upwind flux — reciprocity residual must rise above tolerance, proving the gate detects smuggled inertia. (e) enable a nonlinear viscosity or any force cap (the repo already has a steric force_cap) — superposition must FAIL. (f) use a manufactured field with div u != 0 — observed order must collapse below 1.

validation_steps.step: S3 — Pore-scale DNS in a periodic REV on the project's OWN filament geometry: measure k_ij and phi instead of sourcing them
validation_steps.what_is_measured: The permeability tensor k_ij and the porosity phi of the actual explicit filament configuration, extracted by volume-averaging the resolved Stokes solution; plus their grid-convergence and their symmetry response to network anisotropy.
validation_steps.protocol: Cut a periodic REV out of the real native build: a 1x1x0.4 um cortex patch (dx = 2 nm -> 5.0e7 cells, ~3.0 GB for 15 fp32 fields, filament 4 cells across, ~600 um of filament inside) and a 0.5^3 um interior patch (dx = 2 nm -> 1.56e7 cells, 0.94 GB; dx = 1 nm -> 7.5 GB, still fits 16 GB). Rasterise every filament as a no-slip cylinder of radius 4 nm from the actual node positions. Apply a unit pressure gradient along each of x, y, z; solve resolved Stokes; volume-average the resulting velocity to get k_ij = -mu <v_i> / (dp/dx_j). Compute phi by direct occupancy count. Repeat at dx = 4, 2, 1 nm. Repeat on a deliberately aligned bundle configuration.
validation_steps.pass_criterion: (1) GRID INVARIANCE: extracted k_ij converges with refinement, |k(dx/2) - k(dx)| / k decreasing at the solver's order, and the dx=1 nm vs dx=2 nm difference below the seed-to-seed stochastic spread across >=5 network realisations. (2) ISOTROPY: for the isotropic cortex configuration the three eigenvalues of k_ij agree within the across-seed error bar. (3) ANISOTROPY SIGN-SENSE: for an aligned bundle, k_parallel / k_perp > 1 (correct sign, exponent reported, magnitude not gated). (4) CROSS-CHECK ONLY, not a pass condition: report the measured k against xi^2/C with the project's own xi = 1/sqrt(rho_L) = 25.8 nm (rho_L = 70,686*3 um / (706.9*0.2 um^3) = 1500 um/um^3) and the geometric phi = 1 - 1500*pi*(4 nm)^2 = 0.925. No literature magnitude is required to pass.
validation_steps.negative_control: Run the SAME extraction on an EMPTY REV (no filaments, phi = 1). The gate must return k -> infinity / divergent (or hit an explicit free-fluid guard) and must FAIL the finite-k branch. Second control: the aligned-bundle configuration MUST FAIL the isotropy gate of (2) — without that, the isotropy gate is a gate a broken build cannot fail. Third control: rasterise the filaments at 40 nm radius instead of 4 nm; k must drop by roughly the Kozeny scaling and the gate must flag the geometry mismatch rather than silently accepting it.

validation_steps.step: S4 — THE DECISION GATE: measure how much Darcy actually gets wrong, in the real geometry, by the k-sweep Brinkman bridge
validation_steps.what_is_measured: The cell-by-cell difference between the Stokes-Brinkman solution and the incumbent Darcy solution on IDENTICAL geometry and boundary data, as a function of k, and the exponent with which it vanishes.
validation_steps.protocol: On the native membrane-minus-nucleus domain with the SAME boundary data as the recorded NG-4 run, solve Stokes-Brinkman at k spanning 8 decades around the measured S3 value. For each k compute the relative L2 difference between the Brinkman velocity and the Darcy velocity q/phi over the FLUID cells, and plot against the dimensionless group k/L^2 (L = domain scale). Separately, take k -> inf (free fluid) and confirm the solution converges to the pure-Stokes solution of the same geometry. Report the difference field spatially, not just its norm, so any localisation near boundaries is visible.
validation_steps.pass_criterion: (1) The Darcy-Brinkman difference vanishes as a power law in k/L^2 with measured log-log slope 1.00 +/- 0.05 (the analytically predicted first-order Brinkman correction). (2) At the S3-measured k the difference is bounded by the predicted (ell_B/L)^2 with ell_B = sqrt(k) — the a-priori prediction is 2.0e-5 at L = 0.5 um and 8.9e-8 at L = 7.5 um — with the residual concentrated within ~ell_B of solid faces, not distributed through the bulk. (3) The k -> inf limit reproduces the S2-validated pure-Stokes solution to solver tolerance, and the k -> 0 limit reproduces the incumbent Darcy field. All three are exponent / limit-consistency criteria; no physiological magnitude enters. THIS IS THE PI DECISION POINT: it converts 'is Darcy good enough' from an argument into a measured number on the project's own geometry, and it does so BEFORE committing to a full-cell Stokes rewrite.
validation_steps.negative_control: Mis-scale the Darcy term deliberately — use ell_B = k instead of sqrt(k), or multiply the (mu/k) coefficient by 2. The measured exponent or the offset must break and the gate must FAIL. Second control: run the sweep on a geometry containing a deliberately inserted FREE-FLUID pocket of diameter 20*ell_B (a synthetic bleb). The difference must NOT vanish as k -> 0 inside that pocket, and the gate must report the pocket as a Darcy-invalid region — if it does not, the gate cannot detect the one case where Darcy is genuinely wrong.

validation_steps.step: S5 — Velocity-difference fluid drag (Brinkman I1b2) made force-real, with the 65.9 Pa*s channel removed in the SAME commit
validation_steps.what_is_measured: Whether a free filament immersed in a moving fluid is actually carried by it; whether the fluid/solid force pair is equal-and-opposite and strictly dissipative; whether the coupled system self-propels; and whether any second drag channel survives.
validation_steps.protocol: Add the body-force pair f_solid = +(mu/k)(v_f - v_s) per unit representative nodal volume and its exact negative on the fluid, scattered/gathered by the EXISTING Peskin spread/interp pair (ff/biot_fluid_warp.py:131,169) so the transfer is the verified transpose. Wire it into the surface_porous_transfer and the five *_cytosol_transfer connectors. In the same commit apply the S0 census removals (ff/motility_warp.py:407 physical_node_gammas deleted from every fluid-coupled path; ff/units.py:140 default eta removed; gamma_solid reclassified NUMERICAL-MOBILITY only; ff/network_warp.py 0-D clock retired; ff/implicit_ff.py:170 modal drag deleted or labelled). Tests: (a) release a single unanchored filament in a uniform imposed v_f and track its velocity; (b) sum the fluid and solid force arrays over the closed system; (c) accumulate the pairwise work over a step; (d) run a fully internal-force-only cell for many steps and track COM; (e) set the drag coefficient to zero and compare against the pre-change build.
validation_steps.pass_criterion: (a) the free filament's velocity relaxes MONOTONICALLY toward v_f and the residual |v_s - v_f| decays exponentially, with the measured relaxation exponent independent of dt (grid/step invariance) — a sign-sense plus scaling criterion, no coefficient magnitude needed. (b) sum of all internal fluid+solid forces = 0 to round-off (Newton's 3rd law). (c) pairwise fluid/solid work <= 0 for the solid every step (strictly dissipative, correct sign). (d) COM drift over N steps at round-off — no self-propulsion (Purcell/scallop). (e) with the coefficient zeroed, the run is BIT-IDENTICAL to the pre-change build. (f) the S0 census reports exactly one PHYSICAL-DISSIPATION owner.
validation_steps.negative_control: (a) Reverse the sign of the drag pair — the free filament must accelerate AWAY from v_f and gate (a) must FAIL. (b) Spread with the Peskin stencil but gather with plain trilinear interpolation (breaking the transpose) — gates (b), (c) and (d) must all FAIL, with visible COM drift; this is exactly the co-location-is-not-coupling failure the project measured at 494,802 nodes (cortex moved 39.8 nm while nucleus and MT aster moved 0.0 nm, bit-identical rest vs load). (c) Re-enable ff/motility_warp.py physical_node_gammas alongside the new drag — the S0 census must FAIL and the dissipation ledger must show a ~65,900x excess on that channel, not a silent 2x.

validation_steps.step: S6 — Exterior medium: the PI's baseline actually has media in it (Stokes where Stokes is unambiguously required)
validation_steps.what_is_measured: Hydrodynamic drag and traction on the outer membrane from a real exterior Stokes flow; the resolution honesty of the cell-substrate lubrication film; and whether an IBM blob's effective hydrodynamic radius is what it claims to be.
validation_steps.protocol: Extend the FieldGrid domain to include an OUTSIDE free-fluid region (k -> inf branch of the S2 operator, mu = medium viscosity, no-slip on the membrane mesh, no-slip on the substrate plane at z=0, far-field Dirichlet or a BEM/regularised-Stokeslet exterior closure on the membrane mesh for the unbounded case). Gates: (a) tow a rigid sphere of radius 7.5 um through the bath at constant velocity and measure the drag coefficient; (b) tow it near a plane wall at gap h and compare the measured drag enhancement against the Brenner wall-correction series in h/a; (c) sweep dx and measure the drag on a sphere of radius a for a/dx = 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 to calibrate the effective hydrodynamic radius of the discretisation; (d) with the cell adherent, report the resolved gap thickness and the number of cells across the lubrication film.
validation_steps.pass_criterion: (a) drag/(6*pi*mu*a*v) -> 1 with the expected convergence order (analytic oracle). (b) the measured drag enhancement follows the Brenner series with the correct SIGN and the correct leading exponent in a/h (a scaling-exponent criterion, no magnitude). (c) the extracted effective hydrodynamic radius equals the geometric radius to within the discretisation order for a/dx >= 8, and the report EXPLICITLY states the a/dx below which it does not — this number is then a hard precondition on any IBM filament drag. (d) the lubrication-film cell count is REPORTED and, if < 4 cells across, the artifact carries an explicit BLOCKED status for every quantitative film claim (film thickness during spreading is 10-100 nm, so at dx = 100 nm this WILL be blocked and must say so).
validation_steps.negative_control: (a) Impose free-slip on the sphere — the gate must land on 4*pi and FAIL the 6*pi criterion. (b) Move the wall to h/a = 100 — the enhancement must vanish and the gate must report no wall effect; if it still reports one, the far-field boundary is contaminating the answer (domain-truncation artifact). (c) Run the a/dx = 1 case and confirm the gate FAILS the effective-radius criterion — this is the mandatory demonstration that the blob-radius trap is detectable, since an undetected 25x drag error at dx=100 nm on 4 nm filaments is the single most likely metrics-measuring-the-wrong-thing failure in this track.

validation_steps.step: S7 — Native full-population cost and A/B: does the fluid upgrade survive PI priority 4 (speed)?
validation_steps.what_is_measured: Wall-clock per outer physical step, peak GPU bytes, and inner-iteration counts for Darcy-only vs Stokes-Brinkman at several dx, at the FULL native population — plus the physics delta between them.
validation_steps.protocol: At the full native config (70,686 cortical filaments / 494,802 actin nodes plus the density-x-geometry non-cortical populations, all compartments ON at physiological setpoints, --from-resting), benchmark one outer step for: Darcy at dx = 0.5 um (incumbent baseline); Brinkman at dx = 250, 100, 50 nm. Publish the NG-9 ledger for each: N_unique_active, N_allocated, N_nodes, N_state, peak GPU_bytes, dt_outer, inner iterations. Run the same physics probe (the NG-4 fast/slow ramp) under each and compare the drained/undrained ratio and tau scaling. Then A/B the two default-off speed wins (cg_check_every early-exit, assembled per-fiber coarse) under each fluid backend.
validation_steps.pass_criterion: (1) The NG-4 physics invariants are PRESERVED under every fluid backend: undrained/drained stiffening ratio > 1 with the same sign, and tau(c_v/2)/tau(c_v) = 2.00 +/- 0.05 (the incumbent measured 1.9984) — i.e. the upgrade does not break the poroelastic scaling law it inherits. (2) The complete cost ledger is PUBLISHED for every configuration, including peak GPU bytes, with no biological density lowered to fit memory. (3) cg_check_every early-exit remains BIT-IDENTICAL under the new backend. These are invariance and measurement criteria, not performance targets — the number itself is a FINDING for PI, not a pass/fail.
validation_steps.negative_control: Benchmark a deliberately STRIPPED configuration (cortex only, no nucleus/membrane/NMII/ECM) and confirm the harness REFUSES to emit an authoritative verdict from it and tags the artifact non-authoritative. This project has drawn a conclusion from a coarse or stripped configuration six times and been contradicted natively each time; the benchmark harness must be structurally incapable of the seventh. Second control: run with the per-fiber coarse speed win ON and confirm any physics-invariant drift is FLAGGED rather than absorbed (the assembled coarse path is default-off pending exactly this A/B).

validation_steps.step: S8 — Visualization gate: isolation + cumulative renders that can actually falsify the flow
validation_steps.what_is_measured: Whether the rendered flow field shows the structures the physics predicts, and whether an anomalous field is visible to the eye rather than hidden in a norm.
validation_steps.protocol: Extend ffn_sim/scripts/ac_viz_common.py (currently point-cloud/per-node only) with a volumetric layer: slab-cut scalar field on an arbitrary plane, velocity glyphs, seeded streamlines/streamtubes, and a vorticity-magnitude scene. Produce the cytosol ISOLATION scene (pressure slab + v_f glyphs + streamlines + vorticity + membrane hydraulic-flux hotspots + nucleus no-flux shell) and refresh the CUMULATIVE composed scene (all components, per-node |F| colouring, with the fluid field as a slab underlay). Full native resolution, no downsampling, one self-contained WebGL HTML, verified with scripts/browser_check.py and by eye.
validation_steps.pass_criterion: Browser-verified render (a grep of the HTML is not verification). risks: LOAD PATH THAT SUMS TO ZERO — the primary risk, and it has already happened twice in this project. (a) The pressure force -alpha*V*grad(p) on a closed cell is a gradient field: integrated over a closed surface with uniform p it contributes exactly zero net force and, for a symmetric cell, zero net force per compartment too. A fluid coupling can therefore look wired at every node and transmit nothing, exactly as the crawl traction was isotropic radial grip cancelling laterally with F_net down to one clutch. (b) The mirror failure: at 494,802 nodes under 10 percent strain the cortex moved 39.8 nm while the MT aster and nucleus moved 0.0 nm, bit-identical rest vs load, because merged arrays made the stiffness block-diagonal. A Peskin spread/interp pair with a mismatched stencil reproduces this precisely — the interpolation succeeds, the force is deposited, and nothing moves. MITIGATION: gate the net-force projection and the per-compartment displacement under load, never the per-node force magnitude; and require the S5 free-filament advection test, which fails loudly if the drag is present but ineffective.

METRICS MEASURING THE WRONG THING — this repo has done it at least seven times (basal vs top-down A/A0 twice, a Young-Dupre gate returning 120.0000 degrees by construction, an A/A0 = V/V0 = 1.000 tautology, raw |F| including backbone Lagrange tension). The fluid-specific instances: (a) reporting the Darcy DISCHARGE q as the fluid velocity when the solute-carrying velocity is v_f = v_s + q/phi — the transport oracle already distinguishes them, but a renderer or a report can silently pick the wrong one, and they differ by 1/phi; (b) calling the -alpha*V*grad(p) buoyancy force 'fluid drag' in an artifact when it is proportional to grad p and not to (v_f - v_s), so a filament in quiescent uniform-pressure fluid feels zero drag while the artifact claims hydrodynamic coupling; (c) reporting an IBM per-filament drag as resolved hydrodynamics when the Peskin blob radius is ~dx, making the effective hydrodynamic radius 100 nm instead of 4 nm and the drag ~25x too large; (d) reporting the pore-averaged v_f as if it were the pore-scale velocity a filament actually experiences, which differs by ~1/phi plus the entire unresolved shear structure.

THE 65,900x DRAG DOUBLE-COUNT, currently disarmed only by ff/motility_warp.py being unwired. The moment either the motility/crawl track wires physical_node_gammas (eta = 65.9 Pa*s) or this track wires a Brinkman drag, both are live on the same nodes. The error is not 2x: 65.9 Pa*s IS the poroelastic composite that (mu/k)(v_f - v_s) reconstructs from mu = 1e-3 Pa*s, so the ratio is eta_cyto/eta_solvent = 65,900. Two independent tracks can each land a correct change and jointly produce this. MITIGATION: S0 lands first and is a hard pytest, not a document.

A GATE A BROKEN BUILD CANNOT FAIL. The project has one on record (largest-fragment vs 2nd-largest instead of absolute connectivity). The fluid-specific shapes: (a) the irrotationality gate of S1 passes trivially if the curl diagnostic itself is broken — hence the mandatory solid-body-rotation control; (b) the isotropy gate on k_ij is vacuous unless an aligned network demonstrably FAILS it; (c) an incompressibility gate evaluated on the projected field rather than the pre-projection field always passes; (d) a conservation gate on sum(p) rather than on the general Biot fluid content — the audit already caught exactly this in ff/biot_fluid_warp.py, where pore_mass() is int p dV, not fluid content, and the nominal no-flux step changed sum(p) from 81.0 to 81.8167.

CONCLUDING FROM A COARSE OR STRIPPED CONFIGURATION — six documented occurrences, each later contradicted natively. The acute risk here is that a Stokes-vs-Darcy comparison run at dx = 0.5 um, or on a cortex-only build, or at reduced filament density to fit 16 GB, produces a verdict that native contradicts. Lowering a biological density to fit memory is explicitly forbidden and is the tempting shortcut when the Brinkman grid gets large. MITIGATION: the S7 harness must structurally refuse an authoritative verdict from a stripped config.

A NUMERICAL MOBILITY BEING LAUNDERED INTO A PHYSICAL VISCOSITY. ac/engine/sf_implicit.py mobility_step = dt/gamma and ac/cell/driver.py dt_mu = 0.1/kmax are CFL-derived solver parameters with units of mobility. Once a physical drag exists, the temptation to identify them is strong and would produce a viscosity chosen to make the solver converge — a magic number of the worst kind, since it would then appear in a dissipation ledger. MITIGATION: the S0 census classifies these NUMERICAL-MOBILITY and excludes them from every energy report by construction.

SPEED REGRESSION SWALLOWING PI PRIORITY 4. The arithmetic says Stokes-Brinkman costs ~8 ms/outer step at dx = 250 nm, 0.13 s at 100 nm, 1.04 s at 50 nm, against microseconds for today's Biot step — a 1e4-1e5x fluid cost increase that would make the fluid the dominant term in a simulator whose stated single biggest goal after assembly is speed, and whose long-run purpose is fast parameter sweeps. A fluid upgrade that makes sweeping impossible defeats the purpose it was adopted for. MITIGATION: the S4 decision gate exists precisely so this cost is paid only where it buys measurable physics, and S7 measures it before commitment.

SMUGGLED INERTIA. Any advective term, any first-order upwind flux, any LBM-style relaxation reintroduces inertia at Re = 1e-10 where it is physically meaningless — a lumped/wrong-physics regression that would be very hard to see in a field plot. MITIGATION: the Lorentz reciprocity and exact-reversal gates in S2 detect it directly; they are the reason those gates are non-negotiable.

k AND phi REMAINING LUMPED WHILE THE ARTIFACT CLAIMS OTHERWISE. If the REV measurement (S3) is skipped and only the Brinkman solver lands, the project will have paid a large cost for a solver whose single most important coefficient is still a provisional scalar from a closure the params file itself records as 'NOT in corpus' — i.e. it will have replaced a cheap lumped model with an expensive lumped model. The de-lumping is the point; the solver is the vehicle.

DOMAIN-TRUNCATION ARTIFACT IN THE EXTERIOR BATH. Stokes flow decays as 1/r, so a finite exterior box contaminates the drag on the cell by O(a/L). A drag measurement in a box only 2-3 cell radii wide can be wrong by tens of percent while looking clean. MITIGATION: the Brenner far-wall control in S6 (h/a = 100 must show NO wall effect) detects it.

UNRESOLVED LUBRICATION FILM SILENTLY SETTING SPREADING DYNAMICS. The cell-substrate gap during spreading is 10-100 nm; at dx = 100 nm it is one cell or less. An unresolved film produces an arbitrary hydrodynamic resistance that would then be credited to the lamellipodium — structurally the same failure as the SettlingForce proxy doing the flattening credited to the lamellipodium, in a different channel. MITIGATION: the film resolution is a REPORTED observable with a mandatory BLOCKED status below 4 cells across.
open_questions_for_pi: THE CENTRAL DECISION, framed with the numbers rather than deferred. The measured position is: Darcy is the leading-order asymptotic limit of Stokes in this medium, differing by (ell_B/L)^2 = 2.0e-5 at 0.5 um and 8.9e-8 at 7.5 um with ell_B = sqrt(k) = 2.2-6.5 nm; a fully resolved whole-cell Stokes DNS needs ~4e11 cells (25 TB for 15 fp32 fields — 1580x a 16 GB A5000 and ~300x a full 8xH100 node), so it is infeasible by construction, not merely expensive; whole-cell Stokes-BRINKMAN at 100-250 nm is affordable (0.2 GB, 8-130 ms per outer step) and buys real shear, vorticity, no-slip on large surfaces, free-fluid regions, and fluid-borne drag; pore-scale Stokes DNS in a 0.5-1 um REV is affordable (0.9-3 GB) and de-lumps k_ij and phi from the project's own explicit filament geometry. MY RECOMMENDATION: do S0-S4 unconditionally (weeks, not months) and let the S4 k-sweep MEASURE how much Darcy gets wrong on the real geometry, then decide S5-S6 scope. PI CALL: accept that staging, or override it and go straight to whole-cell Brinkman?

Is 'the cytosol was built as CFD so it must be validated that way' satisfied by the Stokes oracle suite (incompressibility to machine precision, Poiseuille shape ratio 1.5, sphere drag 6*pi*mu*a*v, Lorentz reciprocity, exact reversibility, linearity, second-order MMS convergence) applied to a Brinkman operator that reduces to Stokes wherever k -> inf? Or does the PI require the interior cortical mesh itself to be resolved, which is the 4e11-cell case? These are very different programmes and only the PI can choose.

Priority ordering against PI priority 4 (speed) and priority 5 (parameters as outputs). A fluid upgrade that raises the fluid cost 1e4-1e5x directly opposes the stated single biggest post-assembly goal, while the REV measurement directly serves priority 5 by turning k and phi into outputs. Should the fluid axis be scoped to the REV measurement plus the exterior bath (both cheap, both serve the stated priorities) and the whole-cell Brinkman deferred until after the speed campaign?

Given the PI's baseline is 'cell in MEDIA, adherent on 2D ECM', is the highest-value Stokes target actually the EXTERIOR? There is no extracellular fluid in the simulator at all today. The exterior bath is where Stokes is unambiguously correct (k -> inf), where the oracles are exact (6*pi*mu*a*v, Brenner wall correction), where the cost is low, and where the missing physics is real (hydrodynamic drag on the membrane, bleb expansion resistance, the lubrication film). I believe this is a stronger first move than interior Stokes, but the priority is the PI's.

phi (porosity) is currently a hard PI GAP blocking the NG-7/NG-8 magnitude verdicts. I can compute it geometrically from the population the simulator owns: the cortex solid volume fraction is 1500 um/um^3 x pi(4 nm)^2 = 0.0754, giving phi_fluid = 0.925. Does the PI authorise a MEASURED phi field (derived from explicit geometry, grid-invariance-gated) as the closure of that gap, or must phi remain a literature-sourced scalar? The same question applies to k: may a REV-measured k_ij(x) supersede the provisional 5e-18 m^2 scalar whose Happel-Brenner closure constant the params file records as 'NOT in corpus'?

The I1b2 velocity-difference drag was deferred as PI-KU-gated for lack of an authoritative intracellular (eta_f/k) claim. If k is measured from geometry rather than sourced, does that close the KU gate, or does the coefficient still require an independent literature anchor? This decides whether the five declared-only *_cytosol_transfer connectors can be made force-real at all.

Retirement authority for the drag channels. Deleting ff/motility_warp.py physical_node_gammas, ff/units.py fiber_point_drag's eta=65.9 default, ff/implicit_ff.py's modal 6*pi*eta*R, and the ff/network_warp.py 0-D clock touches feature-frozen and cross-track code, and the crawl/motility track may currently depend on them. Who owns the sequencing, and may this track delete them, or must it only FLAG them via the S0 census and let each owning track remove its own?

Nucleoplasm scope: the nucleus is currently a no-flux hole outside the fluid domain, which makes ac/nucleus/params_i0b2.yaml's gamma_nuc = 6*pi*eta_nuc*a_Stokes legitimate. Should the fluid domain be extended INSIDE the envelope (making the nucleoplasm a solved poroelastic or free-fluid region and requiring gamma_nuc's removal), or does the no-flux hole stand?

Is a spatially varying k_ij(x) that produces vorticity via grad(k) x grad(p) an acceptable intermediate answer to 'make it actually flow'? It gives real, non-potential interior flow at essentially Darcy cost, without a momentum equation. I judge this a legitimate physics upgrade rather than a dodge, because the anisotropy would be MEASURED from geometry, not fitted — but whether it satisfies the PI's intent is the PI's call, not mine.

(4) Zero the indenter: the flow gate (e) must fail (no gradient, no flow) — proving the flow is load-driven, not a residual artifact.

validation_steps.step: T1.8 — Load-unload REVERSIBILITY and the poroelastic rate signature
validation_steps.what_is_measured: The hysteresis loop area of load reaction vs indentation depth over a full load-unload cycle, as a function of loading RATE; and the recovered state's distance from the pre-load state.
validation_steps.protocol: Run cycles at 4 loading rates spanning a decade, in two configurations: (A) L_p = 0, no kinetics, fully converged inner solve — a purely elastic shell + sealed fluid; (B) L_p ≠ 0 and/or ERM Bell kinetics on. Measure loop area normalised by the loading work, and |x_recovered − x_initial| per node. First establish the integration-noise floor from a zero-amplitude cycle.
validation_steps.pass_criterion: (A) normalised loop area and the per-node recovery error are both below the measured zero-amplitude noise floor — reversibility, no magnitude needed; (B) normalised loop area DECREASES monotonically as loading rate decreases across all 4 rates and the linear extrapolation to zero rate passes through the noise floor within its own confidence interval — a rate-dependence SIGNATURE (poroelastic relaxation), not an absolute dissipation number.
validation_steps.negative_control: (1) Run configuration (A) with the inner solve deliberately under-converged (cap iterations so residual/tension ≈ 15%, which is the actual state of the recent SF result): apparent hysteresis must appear and the gate must FAIL — this makes 'unconverged solver masquerading as physics' detectable, which is currently the project's main quantitative blocker. (2) Run (B) at a single rate only: the harness must refuse to emit a verdict (a rate signature cannot be evaluated from one rate) rather than report the loop area as a dissipation result.

validation_steps.step: T1.9 — Crumpling / wrinkling: the deformation length is set by physics, not by the mesh
validation_steps.what_is_measured: The dominant spherical-harmonic degree ℓ* of the deformation pattern under compression (or under lowered tension), as a function of the dimensionless group σR²/κ; and the width of a point-indentation dimple.
validation_steps.protocol: Two sub-protocols. (a) Point indentation: push one vertex inward and measure the radial profile width w of the resulting dimple; sweep σ/κ over a decade. (b) Buckling/crumple: compress the filled shell between plates (or lower σ at fixed enclosed area excess) and take the shape spectrum, extracting ℓ*. Repeat both at subdiv 5 and 6.
validation_steps.pass_criterion: (a) log w vs log(σ/κ) slope = −0.50 ± 0.10 (the tension-bending crossover length sqrt(κ/σ), which the project's own 2026-07-16 design already names as the physical acceptance); (b) log ℓ* vs log(σR²/κ) slope = +0.50 ± 0.10; (c) grid-invariance: w and ℓ* change < 5% between subdiv 5 and 6 — the crumple wavelength is physical, not the mesh Nyquist. All three are exponent/invariance gates with no magnitude.
validation_steps.negative_control: Set κ = 0: the dimple must become grid-limited (w tracks the mesh edge and CHANGES with subdivision) and ℓ* must track the mesh Nyquist degree — the grid-invariance criterion (c) must fail. This is the machine-checkable version of 'a finite-width dimple, not a spike', and it is the gate that distinguishes a real crumple from a numerical one.

validation_steps.step: T1.10 — CONNECTED: the membrane and cortex deform each other ONLY through named connectors (the co-location killer)
validation_steps.what_is_measured: Cross-component response under channel ablation: displacement field of component B when only component A is loaded, decomposed by channel; and the reciprocity of transmitted work.
validation_steps.protocol: Four runs on the same build: (1) load the membrane only, all channels on; (2) load the cortex only, all channels on; (3) same, with the ERM connector's force disabled (k=0 or bound→0 for all tethers) AND the fluid channel disabled — no mechanical path should remain; (4) ERM off, fluid on — the response must be fully attributable to the fluid channel. Fix the ERM areal density EXPLICITLY (a sourced ρ₀, not the one-tether-per-vertex default) and record it, because ρ₀ is currently a function of `membrane_subdivisions` (~58/µm² at subdiv 6 vs ~927 at subdiv 8; audit `:118`).
validation_steps.pass_criterion: (a) Runs 1 and 2 both show a cross-component displacement > 100× the no-load noise floor (each direction of the coupling is real — not one-sided); (b) reciprocity: W_membrane→cortex + W_cortex→membrane = 0 to < 1e-10 relative (Newton 3rd through the connector); (c) run 3 gives BIT-ZERO cross-component response — with every connector off, co-location transmits nothing; (d) channel additivity: the per-channel contributions in run 4 sum to the run-2 total within 1e-8 relative. The recorded ρ₀ and the subdiv are printed in the artifact so the load path's density is never again a mesh knob.
validation_steps.negative_control: Run the identical protocol on TODAY's aliased lane (membrane and cortex both `cell.pos_d`/`cell.f_d`): criterion (c) must FAIL — a nonzero cross-response with every connector off, because the two 'components' share one array. This is the direct executable test for the measured failure where the cortex moved 39.8 nm and the MT aster/nucleus moved 0.0 nm under 10% strain: that bug was block-diagonal stiffness hidden by co-location, and this NC is its detector. Second NC: halve ρ₀ and confirm the transmitted force changes — a load path whose magnitude is insensitive to its own density is not the path it claims to be.
validation_steps.est_effort: 4-6 d; depends on T1.0 and on the cortex-local-arrays step

validation_steps.step: T1.11 — Native population + physiological mesh + GPU residency + the speed baseline for PI priority 4
validation_steps.what_is_measured: Every invariant from T1.4–T1.10 re-evaluated at the full baseline (70,686 cortical filaments / 494,802 actin nodes, membrane at the PI-ratified subdivision, refined nucleus, ERM/LINC at explicit densities, adherent on 2D collagen once that track lands); plus hot-loop D2H copy count, peak GPU bytes, unique-ID population ledger, and wall-clock per accepted step with a per-kernel breakdown.
validation_steps.protocol: Run on the A5000 with the residency profiler and a POSITIVE CONTROL (a deliberate `.numpy()` on a throwaway array outside the loop must register). Write ONE JSON/npz artifact per run (config, population ledger, parameter provenance from `forces_manifest`, per-step telemetry including a t0 row, residual and residual/tension, verdict, and the MEASURED evidence rung — never a hard-coded one). Then A/B the two default-off speed wins (`cg_check_every` early-exit, assembled per-fiber coarse) at native scale.
validation_steps.pass_criterion: (a) every T1.4–T1.10 invariant PASSES unchanged at native scale — it is the INVARIANTS that must be population-invariant, not the numbers; (b) `hot_loop_dtoh_copies == 0` WITH `positive_control == 1` (a zero that is provably non-vacuous); (c) the unique-ID ledger shows each physical filament in exactly one component and the membrane sheet disjoint from the cortex; (d) speed A/B: the early-exit path is BIT-IDENTICAL to the reference at native scale (bitwise, not 'close') before its default flips; the coarse operator is reported with its measured accuracy penalty and stays default-off if any T1 invariant degrades. Wall-clock is REPORTED as the optimisation baseline, not gated.
validation_steps.negative_control: (1) Insert a `marea_d.numpy()[0]` read in the step loop (exactly what the legacy `ff_membrane_cell.py:164` does to compute the reservoir tension): the residency probe must report > 0 and the run must fail. risks: LOAD PATH THAT SUMS TO ZERO, and it is one keyword away: assemble.py:920-933 assigns node_volume ONLY to actin nodes ('membrane nodes carry their OWN mechanics, so V=0'). The engine's MembranePressureFluxAdjointBoundary scatters the fluid reaction via PressureCoupling using node_volume_d — bind it with the incumbent's array and the membrane's adjoint traction is EXACTLY zero while the global Newton-3rd sum still closes at 0 = 0. Mitigation: every closure gate carries a per-channel positive control (each named channel > 100× the measured noise floor) and the membrane quadrature must come from lumped_surface_control_volumes with its partition-of-unity identity asserted.

DOUBLE COUNT of the same physical load: two membrane fluid channels exist — the incumbent's weak-triangle MembranePressureTraction and the engine's PressureCoupling+surface-quadrature adjoint. The native interior-column driver avoids this today by simply NOT invoking the connector force pass, which is why the connector is 'zero force dispatch'. Turning it on without retiring the other doubles the membrane pressure while every conservation identity still closes. Mitigation: a channel-exclusivity assert in forces_manifest, and the omit-mask as the single arbiter of who owns each load.

TAUTOLOGICAL Young-Laplace. Two live tautology generators: the lumped turgor path where dP_mem = 2γ/R is computed FROM the tension (ff_membrane_cell.py:166, network_warp lumped channel) and h8b1_membrane_tension_gate.py which states outright that it 'recovers the SAME γ_tot the force used'. A gate on that path returns a perfect residual by construction — the same class as the Young-Dupre gate that returned 120.0000 degrees. Mitigation: three independent measurements (method-of-planes σ, field-solved Δp, geometric H), a mesh-refinement ORDER criterion instead of a tolerance, and an explicit detector that flags a residual which does not depend on discretisation as TAUTOLOGY rather than PASS.

METRIC MEASURING THE WRONG THING — the specific traps live in this track: analytic sphere volume vs discrete polyhedral volume (already documented at assemble.py:920-930 and already produced a phantom volume-penalty force in Lane D); apparent area vs true triangle area (the KK flux kernel was moved to true-area quadrature for exactly this reason); a volume-conservation gate that passes because nothing moved (the A/A0 = V/V0 = 1.000 tautology, shipped once); and any |F| sum that silently includes the pressure traction or a Lagrange/backbone tension. Mitigation: non-vacuity positive controls, force-family masks, and one named source per observable.

A GATE A BROKEN BUILD CANNOT FAIL. The precedent is the connectivity gate that compared largest-fragment to 2nd-largest instead of absolute connectivity. In this track the equivalents are: volume conservation with L_p = 0 and no load; Newton-3rd closure with a zero channel; 'sphericity ≤ 1' on a mesh that never deforms; and the T1.10 ablation test on an ALIASED array pair, which cannot detect a missing connector. Mitigation: every step in the plan ships a named negative control that must FAIL, and several of those controls are literally today's code — so the gate's teeth are demonstrated on the current build before it is fixed.

UNCONVERGED SOLVER MASQUERADING AS PHYSICS. This is the project's live quantitative blocker: the most recent SF result withheld its magnitude at residual/tension = 15.5%, GATE A's descent never committed a descending candidate in the driver's accepted-step path, and the whole-cell max|PF| plateaus above its own static gate. If K_A engages, k_max jumps ~1000× and dt collapses silently. An under-converged run produces fake hysteresis, fake pressure gradients and fake reciprocity. Mitigation: every artifact carries residual and residual/tension with a t0 row; a run above the declared convergence ceiling emits VOID, never PASS or FAIL; and T1.8 uses a deliberately under-converged run as its negative control so the failure mode is detectable rather than merely warned about.

ENGINE COMPONENT AS A PASSENGER. Every native 'engine-owned' result to date reaches the physics only because _accumulate_all calls into a monkeypatched adapter (cell.membrane = _SliceMembraneAdapter), and every native surface owner is a NoOpSurfaceMechanics. A Track-1 result could look like a membrane component result while the frozen incumbent owned the array, the zeroing and the solve. THE ERM LOAD PATH'S DENSITY IS A MESH KNOB: erm_density_per_um2 defaults to None, giving one tether per membrane vertex, so rho_0 = f(membrane_subdivisions) — about 58/um^2 at subdiv 6 vs about 927/um^2 at subdiv 8 against a sourced ~100/um^2, and no GATE-A or GATE-B script has ever set it (LINC has the identical defect). SEALED INCOMPRESSIBLE INTERIOR ⇒ nm-SCALE MOTION. Lane D's durable finding: at Biot S = 1e-4 the shell cannot visibly bulge locally, and any membrane motion produces a huge div(v_s)/S pressure swing that explodes unless the membrane is co-marched inside the Biot sub-cycle. Two risks follow: gates written around a visible bulge will pass or fail on noise, and a stability failure can be mistaken for physics. Mitigation: gate the pressure field and traction redistribution, not the bulge; establish the noise floor first; co-march the membrane in the sub-cycle; and caption the render so it cannot be misread.

HOT-LOOP HOST READBACK, hiding in the reservoir path. The only existing reservoir-aware tension path reads the area to host every step (marea_d.numpy()[0], ff_membrane_cell.py:163-164). SCOPE CREEP INTO MAGNITUDE. RESERVOIR_STRAIN, L_p, Pi_0, sigma_refl, k_erm, rho_0, phi and the nucleus moduli are all unsourced or PI-GAP.
